_comment: Ground truth for the verifier offline benchmark. Images are real crops pulled from verify_debug/ dumps produced during eval-mini runs across the P0/P1 debugging session (see docs/DESIGN_AND_ROADMAP.md). `ground_truth` is my (the assistant's) independent visual judgment of whether the crop truly shows `target`, made without looking at what the verifier itself said at the time. `ambiguous: true` entries are hard/low-quality crops excluded from strict accuracy scoring but kept as documented edge cases. `note` records why each is interesting.

very close, poorly lit white curved ceramic surface — plausibly a toilet tank/lid but too cropped to confirm independently. Verifier rejected (appropriately cautious).
